entries.question: Kgmu me nephrology department me
entries.answer:
The Department of Nephrology at KGMU provides specialized care for kidney-related conditions and renal transplantation.

**Important Information:**
*   **Department Link:** [Nephrology Department Details](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=61&dept_type=2)
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
*   **Location:** 4th Floor, New OPD Building.

**How to get an appointment:**
1.  **Online:** You can book an appointment through [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2.  **Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or Health Care app to register and book.
3.  **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to 8887019134.
4.  **Walk-in:** You can visit the OPD registration counter on-site. Please bring your Aadhaar card and a mobile phone to receive the OTP. Registration is mandatory and closes at 1:00 PM.

**Important Note:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you have a valid referral letter for the Nephrology department.

entries.question: Patient ko admit krna he
entries.answer:
To get a patient admitted at KGMU, the process depends on the nature of the condition:

**1. For Emergency Cases:**
*   If the patient requires immediate, life-saving care, please go directly to the **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)**. 
*   Emergency services (General and Pediatric) are available 24/7.
*   KGMU provides free medicines and supplies for the first 24 hours of emergency treatment.

**2. For Planned/Non-Emergency Admissions:**
*   **Consultation First:** The patient must first visit the relevant department's OPD (Outpatient Department). You must book an appointment via [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) or the other methods listed below before coming.
*   **Doctor's Referral:** The attending consultant in the OPD will assess the patient. If admission is required, they will provide an admission slip/advice.
*   **Registration:** Take the admission slip to the designated admission counter (usually near the respective department or the main hospital office) to complete the paperwork.

**Booking Methods for OPD/Consultation:**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to 8887019134.
*   **Walk-in:** Visit the registration counter with the patient's Aadhaar card and an active mobile number (for OTP verification). The registration fee is ₹50.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Timings:** The OPD registration counter closes at **1:00 PM** (Mon–Fri) and **12:00 PM** (Sat). Please arrive early.
*   **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for their specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book your appointment in advance to avoid long wait times.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. For your safety, please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or contact information in this chat.

entries.question: reports ko kese download kru
entries.answer:
आप अपनी जाँच रिपोर्ट (Laboratory Reports) KGMU की वेबसाइट से डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं। इसके लिए नीचे दिए गए चरणों का पालन करें:

1. KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर जाएं।
2. वेबसाइट पर **"Patient Corner"** या **"Lab Reports"** का विकल्प ढूंढें।
3. वहां आपको अपना **UHID (Unique Health Identification Number)** और मोबाइल नंबर दर्ज करना होगा।
4. आपके पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर पर एक **OTP** आएगा, उसे दर्ज करें।
5. इसके बाद आप अपनी रिपोर्ट को PDF फॉर्मेट में देख और डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

यदि आपको वेबसाइट पर रिपोर्ट खोजने में समस्या आ रही है, तो कृपया अपनी संबंधित विभाग (जिस विभाग में आपने जाँच करवाई थी) के काउंटर पर जाकर संपर्क करें।

**नोट:** मैं एक एआई हूँ और आपकी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी (जैसे कि रिपोर्ट) तक मेरी पहुँच नहीं है। सुरक्षा के लिए कृपया इस चैट में अपना UHID, आधार नंबर या कोई अन्य व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें।

entries.question: How  to  apply
entries.answer:

1.  **Visit the Official Portal:** Go to [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) and navigate to the **"Courses & Admissions"** section.
2.  **Check for Notifications:** Keep a close watch on the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php). All official admission brochures, application links, and eligibility criteria are published there as soon as the admission cycle begins.
3.  **Application Process:**
    *   Once the application window is open, you will find a link to the online application portal on the website.
    *   You will need to register using a valid email ID and mobile number.
    *   Fill out the application form with your academic details and upload the required documents.
    *   Pay the application fee online through the portal.
    *   Save and print the confirmation page/application receipt for your records.
4.  **Important Note:** KGMU admissions are based on specific entrance examinations or merit-based criteria depending on the course. Please ensure you read the specific brochure for the BMLT course carefully once it is released on the website to understand the required entrance exam or selection process.

If you are looking for information on a specific upcoming session, please check the [Courses & Admission](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) page regularly.

entries.question: how to get online appointment
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment at KGMU, you can use the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select State (Uttar Pradesh) → Select Hospital (KGMU) → Click 'New Appointment' → Choose your department, date, and time slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and OTP verification, then follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of **₹50** for the OPD slip.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Walk-in:** If you visit in person, you must have the patient's **Aadhaar number** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration at the counter.
*   **Referral:** Patients coming from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

For further assistance, you may call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
